def equation(gate_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, parameters: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Equação empírica para log10(|ID|/A) ao longo da curva de transferência."""
    """Improved version of `equation_v2`. Aiming at a two-piece equation representation."""
    a, b, c, d, e, f = parameters
    return a + b * gate_voltage_abs + c * (gate_voltage_abs - d)**2 + e * (gate_voltage_abs - d)**3
